questions.sentence: (   ) tired, I went to bed early.

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) in simple English, this book is easy to read.
questions.explanation: 本は「書かれた」側なので過去分詞で始まる分詞構文。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) finished my homework, I went out.
questions.explanation: 出かける前に宿題を終えていたので、完了形の分詞構文 having + 過去分詞。

questions.prompt: (   ) に入る最も適切なものは？
questions.sentence: (   ) knowing what to do, I asked for help.
questions.explanation: 分詞構文の否定は not を分詞の前に置く。
